title: Aureline M5 retirement countdown
description: Canonical per-domain retirement grace-window countdown for a retiring M5 line, capability, bundle, command / deep link, schema-bearing surface, registry-visible package, or managed / new-tenant feature. Turns retirement from a hidden date in release notes into a visible, inspectable countdown: it names the version the surface was first deprecated in, the cutoff version / date after which it is Retired, the successor route it forwards to, and any remaining overlap window during which the old and new surfaces coexist, plus the no-surprises explanation of what changes at retirement. Affected install / update, settings / help, docs, marketplace, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating retirement countdown truth by hand, so a product surface and an operator / support surface open the same cutoff and successor data without contradiction. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
